turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Haan ji, bachche ko kya hua?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Doctor ye Ishaan hai, 18 mahine ka. 2 din se loose motion ho rahe hain, din mein 6-7 baar.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Ulti? Bukhar? Peshab theek aa raha hai?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Ek baar ulti hui thi. Halka bukhar hai. Peshab aa raha hai par kam.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Temperature 99.8, pulse 120, weight 10 kg. Aankhen dhansi nahi hain, abhi dehydration nahi hai. Ye acute gastroenteritis hai, pet ka infection.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Maine kal Eldoper ki aadhi goli de di thi, padosan ne boli thi.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Nahi nahi, chhote bachchon ko Eldoper bilkul nahi deni, wo khatarnak hai. Band karo.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Theek hai doctor. Ise kisi dawai se allergy nahi hai.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Har loose motion ke baad ORS 50 ml pilana hai, chammach se dheere dheere. Aur Zinc syrup 20 mg roz ek baar, 14 din tak, motion band ho jaaye tab bhi poora karna.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Haan, doodh aur khana band nahi karna. Agar potty mein khoon aaye, 6 ghante se zyada peshab na aaye, ya bachcha bahut sust ho jaaye, toh turant le aana.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Theek hai, phir kab dikhana hai?

trap: Mother gave Eldoper (loperamide); doctor stops it.
